home.eyebrow: A NEW PERSPECTIVE ON ANCIENT EGYPT
home.description: Meet the people, ideas and wonders of ancient Egypt. Find what moves you, then make the journey your own.
home.heroDate: The golden funerary mask · Photograph by Bjørn Christian Tørrissen
home.featuredDescription: Come closer to ancient Egypt through real artifact photography. A new story begins with every object.
home.journeyDescription: A few thoughtful tools to help you spend less time planning and more time discovering.
home.tourText: Choose your time and interests. We’ll build a suggested route, one remarkable stop at a time.
home.scanText: Open an artifact’s QR link, or try the image recognition demo to discover its story.
home.mapText: Explore our schematic floor map and see your planned stops together.
home.visitEyebrow: MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR VISIT
home.visitText: Discover the visitor tools, accessibility options and learning quests that bring the collection closer.
home.note: Concept experience · Explore at your own pace

services.title: A thoughtful visit starts here.
services.description: Plan a comfortable experience. These are prototype service categories; check the museum’s official guidance for your visit.
services.accessibilityText: Choose a step-free preference in the planner. Our schematic routes use a lift connector; real accessibility routes must be confirmed on site.
services.amenitiesText: Use the map’s example service markers for restrooms, a café and a quiet rest area. Locations are illustrative.
services.safetyText: If you need help, contact museum staff. Follow posted safety instructions and marked exits. The prototype cannot locate you or provide emergency navigation.
services.privacyText: Images are sent only when you submit an image for recognition. In demo mode there is no image analysis or saved upload. Avoid including people or sensitive information.
